title: Twig: Parallel and Memory-Efficient Tree Speculative Decoding for Hybrid-Attention LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.01651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emerging LLMs increasingly interleave full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context serving costs. Tree speculative decoding could further accelerate these hybrid models, but recurrent linear-attention layers carry parent-dependent states. Existing engines therefore verify proposal trees sequentially and snapshot the full state per node, causing latency and memory to grow with tree and batch sizes. We present Twig, a kernel--runtime co-design for tree speculative decoding of hybrid LLMs. Twig derives a tree-structured factorization of the linear-attention recurrence and realizes it with a resource-efficient GPU kernel that verifies all nodes in parallel, accelerating linear-attention tree verification by 3.4--7.7$\times$. It losslessly represents speculative state updates as token-level factors and reconstructs only the accepted state, reducing transient state memory by 82--99$\times$ and freeing GPU mem

translated_title: Twig：面向混合注意力大语言模型的并行且内存高效的树形推测解码
translated_abstract: 新兴的大语言模型越来越多地将全注意力与循环线性注意力交织结合，以降低长上下文推理服务的成本。树形推测解码可进一步加速这类混合模型，但循环线性注意力层携带有依赖于父节点的状态。因此，现有引擎只能顺序地验证提议树，并为每个节点快照完整状态，导致延迟和内存开销随树规模与批大小增长而不断攀升。我们提出了Twig，一种面向混合大语言模型树形推测解码的内核与运行时协同设计。Twig推导出线性注意力递归的树结构化因子分解，并通过一个资源高效的GPU内核加以实现，可并行验证所有节点，将线性注意力树验证速度提升3.4至7.7倍。它以无损方式将推测状态更新表示为token级因子，仅重构被接受的状态，从而将瞬态状态内存降低82至99倍，释放了GPU显存……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Twig通过对线性注意力递归进行树结构化因子分解并配合并行GPU内核，实现了混合注意力大语言模型的高效树形推测解码，将树验证加速3.4至7.7倍，同时将瞬态状态内存降低82至99倍。
en_tdlr: Twig enables parallel, memory-efficient tree speculative decoding for hybrid-attention LLMs via a tree-structured factorization of the linear-attention recurrence, accelerating tree verification by 3.4-7.7x and reducing transient state memory by 82-99x.
